quotes.text: The Swift Boat Veterans for Truth spent ~$22M in 2004 — modest by ad standards, but it dominated 60% of network news cycles for six weeks.
The '16 words' on Iraqi yellowcake uranium appeared in Bush's January 2003 State of the Union. The CIA had warned the claim was unreliable.
*Loose Change* (2005) racked up 2.2 billion estimated YouTube views before YouTube was tracking carefully.
Glenn Beck went from CNN Headline News to Fox primetime in Jan 2009. By Apr 2011 his audience had outgrown the network's tolerance.
A 2007 Politico analysis tracked 67% of Drudge lead links being picked up by cable news within 24 hours.
Trump first floated birtherism on *The View* in March 2011. By July 2011 his Fox News appearances were six times their pre-birther rate.
On April 27, 2011, President Obama held a press conference to release his long-form birth certificate. Trump took credit for the moment 90 minutes later.
By 2008 Pew estimated 32% of U.S. adults had received a political chain email; the average forward chain reached 6.2 recipients.
